title: 政府資訊公開
summary: 依政府資訊公開法第 7 條應主動公開的資訊，在本站的對應頁面、尚待建置的項目與權責單位。
bodyMarkdown:
> **原型說明**：下表逐項對照政府資訊公開法第 7 條第 1 項應主動公開的資訊。已有頁面者直接連結；標示「待建置」者尚無對應頁面，已列出權責單位，正式上線前須補齊。權責單位為建議，待各單位確認。

## 一、主動公開項目對照
| 項目 | 本站對應 | 狀態／權責單位 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 一、條約、對外關係文書、法規命令及法規性質之行政規則 | [法令規章](/policy/legal/) | 已有頁面 |
| 二、政府機關之組織、職掌、地址、電話、傳真、網址及電子郵件信箱帳號 | [關於疾管署](/about/)、[聯絡我們](/contact/) | 已有頁面 |
| 三、行政指導有關文書 | 待建置 | **待建置**（權責：秘書室） |
| 四、施政計畫、業務統計及研究報告 | [開放資料與統計](/data/)、[出版品](/publications/)、[研究報告](/research/) | 已有頁面 |
| 五、預算及決算書 | [疾病管制署預算與決算書（資料集）](/data/#dataset.budget-final-accounts) | 已有頁面 |
| 六、請願之處理結果及訴願之決定 | 待建置 | **待建置**（權責：秘書室（訴願、請願承辦）） |
| 七、書面之公共工程及採購契約 | [採購公告](/procurement/)（招標與決標資訊；契約本文待建置） | 已有頁面；契約本文 **待建置**（權責：秘書室） |
| 八、支付或接受之補助 | 待建置 | **待建置**（權責：主計室） |
| 九、合議制機關之會議紀錄 | 待建置 | **待建置**（權責：秘書室） |

## 二、申請提供政府資訊
非主動公開的資訊，得依政府資訊公開法向本署申請提供。原型階段請先透過[聯絡我們](/contact/)提出，並註明所需資訊的內容與用途；正式站將提供線上申請與辦理進度查詢（待建置）。

## 三、限制公開或不予提供
涉及個人隱私、營業祕密、國家安全或其他法律規定應保密者，依政府資訊公開法第 18 條等規定限制公開或不予提供，並於回覆中說明理由。

## 四、授權
主動公開的資料原則上依[開放資料授權](/policy/open-data/)釋出。

en.title: Government information disclosure
en.summary: Where the information that must be proactively disclosed under Article 7 of the Freedom of Government Information Law can be found on this site, and which items are still to be built.
en.bodyMarkdown:
> **Prototype note:** The table maps each item that Article 7(1) of the Freedom of Government Information Law requires agencies to disclose proactively. Items marked "to be built" have no page yet; the responsible unit is listed and must be filled in before launch. Units are proposals pending confirmation.

## 1. Proactive disclosure items
| Item | Where on this site | Status / responsible unit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Treaties, foreign-relations documents, regulations and administrative rules | [Laws and regulations](/policy/legal/) | Available |
| Organisation, duties, address, phone, fax, website and email | [About](/about/), [Contact](/contact/) | Available |
| Documents on administrative guidance | To be built | Secretariat |
| Policy plans, statistics and research reports | [Open data](/data/), [Publications](/publications/), [Research](/research/) | Available |
| Budgets and final accounts | [Budget and final accounts dataset](/data/#dataset.budget-final-accounts) | Available |
| Outcomes of petitions and appeal decisions | To be built | Secretariat |
| Public works and procurement contracts | [Procurement notices](/procurement/) (contract text to be built) | Secretariat |
| Subsidies paid or received | To be built | Accounting Office |
| Minutes of collegial bodies | To be built | Secretariat |

## 2. Requesting government information
Information that is not proactively disclosed can be requested under the Law. During the prototype, please use [Contact us](/contact/) and describe what you need and why. Online requests and progress tracking are to be built.

## 3. Restrictions
Information involving personal privacy, trade secrets, national security or other legally confidential matters may be withheld, with reasons given in the reply.

## 4. Licence
Proactively disclosed data is released under the [open data licence](/policy/open-data/).
